pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:0.6: ime kho panayyāyo tiṃsa nissaggiyā pācittiyā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo bahupatte sannicayaṃ karonti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:1.3: manussā vihāracārikaṃ āhiṇḍantā passitvā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo bahupatte sannicayaṃ karissanti pattavaṇijjaṃ vā bhikkhuniyo karissanti āmattikāpaṇaṃ vā pasāressantīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:1.6: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo pattasannicayaṃ karissantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:1.8: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo pattasannicayaṃ karontīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:1.11: hi nāma bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo pattasannicayaṃ karissanti
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:1.13: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:1.14.1: yā pana bhikkhunī pattasannicayaṃ kareyya nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:2.1.7: tayo pattassa vaṇṇā ukkaṭṭho patto majjhimo patto omako patto.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:2.1.9: aḍḍhāḷhakodanaṃ gaṇhāti catubhāgaṃ khādanīyaṃ tadūpiyaṃ byañjanaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:2.1.11: nāḷikodanaṃ gaṇhāti catubhāgaṃ khādanīyaṃ tadūpiyaṃ byañjanaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:2.1.13: patthodanaṃ gaṇhāti catubhāgaṃ khādanīyaṃ tadūpiyaṃ byañjanaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:2.1.19: nissajjitabbo saṅghassa vā gaṇassa vā ekabhikkhuniyā vā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:2.1.21: tāya bhikkhuniyā saṅghaṃ upasaṅkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā vuḍḍhānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evamassa vacanīyo
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:2.1.22: ayaṃ me ayye patto rattātikkanto nissaggiyo imāhaṃ saṅghassa nissajjāmīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:2.1.27: ayaṃ patto itthannāmāya bhikkhuniyā nissaggiyo saṅghassa nissaṭṭho.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:2.1.28: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ saṅgho imaṃ pattaṃ itthannāmāya bhikkhuniyā dadeyyāti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:2.1.29: tāya bhikkhuniyā sambahulā bhikkhuniyo upasaṅkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā vuḍḍhānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evamassu vacanīyā
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:2.1.30: ayaṃ me ayyāyo patto rattātikkanto nissaggiyo imāhaṃ ayyānaṃ nissajjāmīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:2.1.35: ayaṃ patto itthannāmāya bhikkhuniyā nissaggiyo ayyānaṃ nissaṭṭho.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:2.1.36: yadi ayyānaṃ pattakallaṃ ayyāyo imaṃ pattaṃ itthannāmāya bhikkhuniyā dadeyyunti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:2.1.37: tāya bhikkhuniyā ekaṃ bhikkhuniṃ upasaṅkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evamassa vacanīyā
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:2.1.38: ayaṃ me ayye patto rattātikkanto nissaggiyo
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:2.2.11: nissaggiyaṃ pattaṃ anissajjitvā paribhuñjati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:2.3.2: antoaruṇaṃ adhiṭṭheti vikappeti vissajjeti nassati vinassati bhijjati acchinditvā gaṇhanti vissāsaṃ gaṇhanti
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:3.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo nissaṭṭhapattaṃ na denti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:3.3: na bhikkhave bhikkhuniyā nissaṭṭhapatto na dātabbo
